sections.title: Parties, property and project description
sections.text:
**1. Parties and Property.** This Contract is made on 10/01/2026 between Sunrise Pools LLC, a Massachusetts limited liability company, 100 Bay St, Springfield, phone (813) 555-0100, email office@sunrise.test ("Contractor"), and Jordan Rivers, 12 Main St, Riverview, phone (813) 555-0111, email jordan@example.test ("Owner"). The work will be performed at 12 Main St, Riverview, Hillsborough County, Massachusetts (the "Property"). Owner states that Owner owns the Property.

**Project.** Rivers backyard: Tile repair, as described in Contractor's Estimate No. EST-0042, version R1, dated 09/10/2026 and accepted by Owner on 09/12/2026 (the "Estimate").
sections.option_title: Parties and property: individual owner or owners

sections.title: Scope of work and exclusions
sections.text:
**2. Scope of Work.** Contractor will furnish the labor, materials and equipment to perform the work described in the Estimate, which is attached and made part of this Contract (the "Work"). The Work includes only what the Estimate lists. Quantities, measurements, product models, colors and finishes are as stated in the Estimate. If the Estimate and the terms of this Contract conflict, this Contract controls, except that the Estimate controls on quantities, models and finishes.

**Not included.** The following are not part of the Work unless added by a signed Change Order: {exclusions_list}. Anything not listed in the Estimate is also not included.

**Owner-supplied items.** Owner will supply: none. Contractor is not responsible for the quality, fitness, delivery timing or warranty of owner-supplied items.
sections.option_title: Scope: accepted estimate incorporated, contract controls on conflict

sections.title: Contract price
sections.text: **3. Contract Price.** Owner will pay Contractor a fixed total of $1,800.00 (the "Contract Price") for the Work. The Contract Price changes only by a Change Order signed by both parties under Section 5. The Contract Price includes all sales tax Contractor pays on materials. No sales tax is added to this Contract.

sections.title: Payment schedule, methods and late payment
sections.text:
**4. Payments.** Owner will pay the Contract Price as follows: On completion (100%): $1,800.00. Each payment is due on the date or at the milestone shown. Contractor will send a written request for each payment when it becomes due, and a written receipt for every payment received, showing the amount, date, method and remaining balance.

**How to pay.** Payments are accepted only by: Zelle (pay@sunrise.test); Check, made out or sent to Sunrise Pools LLC (Zelle: pay@sunrise.test). Do not pay cash to any worker, and do not send payment to any person or account not listed here, even if asked. If you receive payment instructions that differ from this list, call Contractor at (813) 555-0100 before paying.

**Late payment.** If a payment is not received by its due date, Contractor may suspend the Work as described in Section 13.
sections.option_title: Milestone schedule, receipts, no late charge

sections.title: Change orders
sections.text: **5. Change Orders.** Any change to the Work, the Contract Price or the schedule must be in a written Change Order signed by Owner and Contractor. Each Change Order is a one-page addendum to this Contract that refers to this Contract by date and number and states only: what is added or removed; the Contract Price before the change; the amount of the change (a removal is a credit); the new Contract Price; any change to the payment schedule; and the effect on the schedule in working days. Contractor will not start changed or extra work until the Change Order is signed. Work not affected by the change continues. Verbal requests, texts and emails are requests only, not Change Orders. Everything in this Contract not changed by a Change Order stays the same.
sections.option_title: Signed change order before changed work starts

sections.title: Schedule, start conditions, delays and weather
sections.text:
**6. Schedule.** Contractor estimates that the Work will start on or about 11/02/2026 and take about 15 working days. These dates are estimates, not guarantees. Work starts after all of these have happened: this Contract is signed by both parties; the deposit is received; required permits are issued; required HOA approval is received; and Owner has made the selections listed in Section 10 by their deadlines.

**Delays.** The schedule is extended, day for day, for delays Contractor does not control, including: weather that prevents safe or proper work; permit, inspection or utility company delays; manufacturer or supplier delays; concealed conditions under Section 8; Change Orders; late payments; Owner's late selections or decisions; lack of access under Section 7; work by Owner's other contractors; and natural disasters, declared emergencies or government orders. Contractor will tell Owner in writing of a delay and its expected length within {delay_notice_days} business days of knowing about it.

sections.title: Site access and owner responsibilities
Concealed and unforeseen conditions
sections.text: **8. Concealed Conditions.** The Contract Price is based on conditions that can be seen during a normal visual inspection before signing. If Contractor finds a condition that was hidden or could not reasonably be known, or that differs from what the Estimate assumes, such as rot, water damage, mold, termite damage, hidden pipes or wiring, structural defects, code violations in existing work, or hazardous materials, Contractor will stop work on the affected area, notify Owner in writing with photos within {concealed_notice_days} business day(s), and propose the price and schedule effect of dealing with it. Contractor will not correct the condition without a signed Change Order. If Owner decides not to correct it, Contractor may complete the rest of the Work where that can be done properly, and is not responsible for the condition or for its effect on the Work.

sections.title: Permits and inspections
sections.text: **9. Permits and Inspections.** Contractor will apply for the building permits the Work requires and schedule the required inspections. Permit fees are included in the Contract Price. Owner will sign the permit documents that require the owner's signature within {owner_response_days} business days of receiving them. Contractor will not start work that requires a permit before the permit is issued, and will not request the first inspection until the permit is issued. Delays caused by the building department or by failed inspections of Owner-supplied items are excusable delays under Section 6. If an inspector requires work beyond the Estimate, it is handled by Change Order, except to correct Contractor's own work, which Contractor fixes at no charge.
sections.option_title: Contractor pulls permits; Owner records the Notice of Commencement

sections.title: Materials, selections and substitutions
sections.text: **10. Materials and Selections.** Owner will make the selections listed here by the dates shown: {selection_deadlines_table}. A late selection extends the schedule. Once Owner approves a selection in writing and Contractor orders it, changing it is a Change Order, including any restocking fee the supplier charges. If a specified product is discontinued or backordered for more than {backorder_days} days, Contractor will propose an equal or better substitute in writing, and will not use it without Owner's written approval. If Owner prefers to wait for the original product, the schedule is extended. Materials remain Contractor's property until paid for, and leftover materials that Owner paid for are left with Owner unless Owner asks Contractor to remove them.

sections.title: Workmanship warranty and manufacturer warranties
sections.text:
**11. Warranty.** Contractor warrants that the Work will be free from defects in workmanship for 12 months from the date of substantial completion (the "Warranty Period"). If a defect in workmanship appears during the Warranty Period, Contractor will repair it, or at Contractor's choice replace the defective part of the Work, at no charge. This is Contractor's only warranty; it does not promise any refund.

**Manufacturer warranties.** Products and equipment carry their manufacturers' warranties, which Contractor will pass to Owner at completion along with registration information. Contractor does not add its own warranty to manufactured products, but will install them according to the manufacturer's instructions.

**Not covered.** The warranty does not cover: normal wear; damage from misuse, neglect, lack of the maintenance described in the care instructions Contractor provides, accidents, storms, flooding, settling of the ground or structure not caused by the Work, or pests; work or repairs by anyone other than Contractor; owner-supplied materials; natural variation in materials described in Section 10; conditions Owner chose not to correct under Section 8; and minor hairline cracks in concrete, grout or plaster that do not affect function.

**How to make a claim.** Owner will notify Contractor in writing at office@sunrise.test within {warranty_notice_days} days of noticing a problem, with photos if possible, and will give Contractor access to inspect within {warranty_inspect_days} business days. Contractor will tell Owner in writing whether the problem is covered and, if covered, schedule the repair. Owner will give Contractor the chance to inspect and repair before hiring anyone else to fix a covered item.

sections.title: Completion, punch list, final payment and lien releases
sections.text:
**12. Completion and Final Payment.** The Work is "substantially complete" when it can be used for its intended purpose, has passed final inspection, even if minor items remain. Contractor will notify Owner in writing when the Work is substantially complete and walk through it with Owner within {walkthrough_days} business days. At the walkthrough, Owner and Contractor will sign a written punch list of remaining items. Owner may hold back {punch_holdback_amount} from the final payment until the punch list is finished; Contractor will finish the punch list within {punch_completion_days} business days, unless an item depends on a backordered product. Items not on the signed punch list, other than hidden defects, are covered by the warranty in Section 11 rather than the punch list.

**Final payment documents.** With the final invoice, Contractor will give Owner: (1) releases of lien from Contractor and from each subcontractor or supplier that served Owner with a Notice to Owner, for amounts paid so far, with final releases on receipt of final payment; (2) manufacturer warranties and care instructions; and (3) any inspection approvals or certificates of completion. The final payment, less any punch-list holdback, is due within {final_payment_days} days after these documents are delivered.
sections.option_title: Final payment at substantial completion, small punch-list holdback

sections.title: Suspension and termination
sections.text:
**13. Suspension and Termination.**
**Suspension by Contractor.** If a payment is more than {suspension_trigger_days} days late, or Owner does not provide access under Section 7, Contractor may suspend the Work after giving Owner {suspension_notice_days} business days' written notice. The schedule is extended for the suspension, and Owner will pay Contractor's documented costs of demobilizing and remobilizing.
**Termination by Contractor.** If the cause of a suspension is not corrected within {contractor_termination_days} days after the suspension starts, Contractor may terminate this Contract by letter stating the reason, sent by certified mail, return receipt requested, to Owner's address in this Contract, with a copy by email.
**Termination by Owner.** If Contractor fails to perform the Work as this Contract requires, Owner may give Contractor written notice describing the failure. If Contractor does not begin to correct it within {owner_cure_days} business days after receiving the notice and diligently complete the correction, Owner may terminate this Contract by a second written notice.
**Payment on termination.** On any termination, Owner will pay Contractor for Work performed up to the termination date, valued on the basis of the Contract Price and the payment schedule, plus materials ordered for this Work that cannot be returned or cancelled (which become Owner's property), less payments already made. If Owner terminates under this section, Owner may deduct Owner's reasonable, documented cost to correct Contractor's defective work. Contractor will give Owner releases of lien for amounts paid.
sections.option_title: Asymmetric: Contractor may suspend or terminate for non-payment or access; Owner for cause

sections.title: Dispute resolution
sections.text: **14. Disputes.** If a dispute arises under this Contract, the parties will first meet (in person or by video) within {negotiation_days} days after either gives written notice of the dispute, to try to resolve it. If it is not resolved within {negotiation_days} days after that meeting, either party may request mediation by a mediator in Hillsborough County, with the mediator's fee shared equally. If mediation does not resolve the dispute within {mediation_days} days after the request, either party may file suit. Any suit will be filed in the state courts for Hillsborough County, Massachusetts. Each party will pay its own attorney's fees and costs, except as a statute or court rule provides otherwise. Nothing in this section prevents Contractor from recording or enforcing a claim of lien within the time the law allows, or either party from seeking emergency relief from a court.
sections.option_title: Package A: negotiation, mediation, then court in the property's county

sections.title: Limitation of liability and insurance
sections.text: **15. Liability and Insurance.** Except for bodily injury, damage to property other than the Work caused by Contractor's negligence, and fraud or intentional misconduct, Contractor's total liability for all claims arising from this Contract will not exceed the Contract Price. Neither party is liable to the other for indirect or consequential losses, such as loss of use, lost rent, temporary housing, or lost profits, except as this Contract states otherwise. Owner is responsible for insuring the Property, including the Work as it is installed, under Owner's homeowner's policy.
sections.option_title: Liability limited to the Contract Price; no indirect damages

sections.title: Offer validity and acceptance
sections.text: **16. Offer and Acceptance.** Contractor has signed this Contract as an offer, which remains open until 10/30/2026. If Owner has not signed by then, the offer expires, and Contractor may update the price and schedule before offering again. This Contract takes effect when both parties have signed it.
sections.option_title: Validity date tied to the estimate

sections.title: Cleanup, debris and site protection
sections.text: **17. Cleanup and Protection.** Contractor will protect floors, fixtures and finished surfaces in the work path, keep the work area reasonably tidy at the end of each working day, and remove construction debris from the Property {debris_frequency}. At completion Contractor will remove its tools, equipment and debris and leave the work area broom-clean. Detailed or professional cleaning is not included. Contractor may place a dumpster or trailer at {dumpster_location}; Owner confirms that location is allowed by any HOA.
sections.option_title: Daily tidy and final cleanup, debris removal included

sections.title: Photos and marketing permission
sections.text: **18. Photos.** Contractor may take photos and video of the Work for its job records, warranty and permit purposes only. Contractor will not use them for advertising.

sections.title: Entire agreement, notices, electronic signatures, severability, governing law
sections.text:
**19. General Terms.**
**Entire agreement.** This Contract, the Estimate, the attachments listed below and any signed Change Orders are the entire agreement between Owner and Contractor. They replace all earlier discussions, messages and proposals. Only a written document signed by both parties can change this Contract. Attachments: Estimate EST-0042-R1.
**Notices.** Formal notices under this Contract (delay, concealed condition, suspension, termination, warranty claim, dispute) must be in writing and sent to the addresses in Section 1, by email and by one of: hand delivery, certified mail, or a nationally recognized courier. A termination notice from Contractor is also sent by certified mail, return receipt requested. Day-to-day scheduling messages may be sent by text or messaging app.
**Electronic signatures and records.** Before signing, Owner consented to receive and sign this Contract electronically on the consent screen that is part of the signing record. Electronic signatures on this Contract, its notices and Change Orders have the same effect as handwritten signatures under the federal Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act and the Uniform Electronic Transactions Act as adopted in Massachusetts. Each party will receive a complete copy of the signed Contract. Owner may request a paper copy at no charge by contacting Contractor.
**Severability.** If any part of this Contract is found unenforceable, the rest remains in effect, and the unenforceable part will be applied to the greatest extent the law allows.
**Governing law.** The laws of the State of Massachusetts govern this Contract.
**No waiver.** Accepting a late payment or allowing a delay once does not waive the right to insist on the terms later.
**Assignment.** Neither party may assign this Contract without the other's written consent, except that Contractor may use licensed subcontractors for parts of the Work and remains responsible for their work.
